what_this_does_NOT_say: It does NOT say flint is bad, unavailable, or refused upstream. Both repos exist, are downloadable, and upstream mlx-lm now serves the architecture.
It does NOT say the swap failed. 0.7.3.dev2 installed and is serving; its bundled runtime is simply pinned one commit-range behind the feature.
It does NOT authorise any download. Every step of T-200/T-201 is TIER-A: bytes stay the owner's decision.
It does NOT make R-14 wrong. R-14 said both runtimes EXIST and listed four blockers; P4 is a statement about THIS build, and it was already false when R-14 was written.
